docs.message:
docs(pdt42): test thanks and unpaid contribution already in the first draft

## Intent

The first draft of the MVP should already test the business model: do thanks arrive, and do creators contribute without pay? The test group gets no explanation of the thanks, so the platform has to make it self-evident.

## Key changes

- D8 has two new riskiest assumptions for the first draft: "Thanks arrive without being explained" (thanks for at least 3 listed apps within 4 weeks) and "Creators contribute without payment" (talks with every creator after listing and after 4 weeks).
- The implementation of the first draft states that the thanks is explained to no one.
- The finding that the first draft tests no business-model assumption is resolved; the development plan extends KD-19.
